_comment: Decrease-only baseline for the independently reported DS-Q006 partial application-boundary categories. New or growing signatures fail; removals stay visible as tightening opportunities.

categoryDefinitions.native-reconstruction: Native button/input/select/textarea markup anywhere in production application TSX/JSX.
categoryDefinitions.raw-shared-chrome-literals: Raw color, radius, duration, font-family or shadow literals only in shared app chrome roots: src/styles, src/ui, src/vertical/surface and src/features/_shared.
categoryDefinitions.undocumented-ds-writes: Application declarations in the reserved --ds-* namespace that are not shipped by production DS CSS or compiler output.
categoryDefinitions.supplier-imports: Direct imports/requires of visual or behavior suppliers instead of public Rottay contracts.
categoryDefinitions.tenant-style-branch: CSS selectors that bind visual behavior to a concrete tenant identity.
categoryDefinitions.i18n-bypass: Declared but not yet implemented; this file does not claim i18n-boundary coverage.
